elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon either expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company’s request, “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for a period of up to 6 months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “at HDI’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return all Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI must “return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI’s possession or control.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The return must be “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return deadline is “within 30 days after such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete the returned Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires HDI to “thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after deleting the Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires HDI to “certify such deletion to the Company in writing.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must apply following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 is triggered “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The Company may request transition assistance for up to 6 months, which encompasses a 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: HDI must return the specified Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The added Section 4.3 fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It covers both expiration and termination, provides up to six months of requested transition assistance at HDI’s then-current rates, requires return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and requires subsequent deletion with written certification. The amendment is confined to the missing exit mechanics and does not alter or contradict the existing term, termination, or payment provisions.
